title: sorghum liebmannii
intro: Sorghum liebmannii, commonly known as Mexican hop sorgo, is a plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as lowering cholesterol levels and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Sorghum liebmannii are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, and act as a natural diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
